Nuance (not a defect): owner-level close is strict LIFO within the sync triple but init_once, though opened last among service owners, closes last rather than first; this matches the stated design 'init_once closes AFTER sync owners' and no dependency runs in either direction between the sibling services

checks.name: Fixture semantics (tests/worker-initonce.h)
evidence: Only documented behavior asserted: pending=1 grant on begin (lines 31,47), complete stores context with CHECK_ONLY read-back (32,34,54-55,62), CHECK_ONLY on never-begun fails with GetLastError 997 (37), unknown flag bit 0x8 fails with 87 (39); header comment lines 3-10 state exactly this contract

Duplicate-complete (line 35) asserts failure only - 'if(InitOnceComplete(...))return -48' - with NO GetLastError pin; the only pinned codes are 997 and 87, both documented (also in mb_win_init_once.h:26,48,57-58)

LastError contract preserved: adapter saves/restores last_error on success in begin/complete (mb_win_init_once.c:119/127/134/147/153/166/170 and 175+); thread_begin hook (worker-fixture.c:48) sits in the SetLastError(44)->GetLastError read(61) window but only makes successful calls, same convention as the sync calls already in that window; thread_complete (67) runs after the worker_error read (61); finish (159) runs AFTER the -18 GetLastError check (154) and after sync_finish (156) - exact reverse of prepare order (sync_prepare 94 -> initonce_prepare 98)

Observation (non-defect, unreachable in asserted profiles): CreateThread-failure path (worker-fixture.c:104-108) calls sync_finish but not initonce_finish. Harmless: if the thread never ran, once_b was never begun (prepare's CHECK_ONLY passes create=0 per mb_win_init_once.c:121), once_a's sidecar is COMPLETE and its re-zeroed storage (worker-initonce.h:41) is never touched again, so owner close (requires all sidecars COMPLETE/quiet, mb_win_init_once.c:91-92) still succeeds; mirrors the sync slice which also skips finish in mb_worker_fixture_fail paths
